title: Gulfview Cottage | KEY.co
description_expanded: As you ascend to the second story, you'll discover three more inviting bedrooms. The second bedroom is furnished with a queen-sized bed, custom built-in wardrobe closets, and balcony access. The third bedroom serves as the king master suite, complete with an ensuite bathroom. This spacious master bedroom includes a closet with generous storage, new furnishings, and access to the front balcony. The private master bathroom features a marble single vanity and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower. Continuing on the second floor, you'll find a common living space with a day bed and a large flat-screen TV—ideal as a secondary lounge area for kids or teenagers. The fourth bedroom, located at the rear of the home, offers a closet, dresser, and ample storage. Adjacent to this bedroom is a shared full bathroom, equipped with a single vanity and a tub & shower combo, serving the front queen and twin bedrooms. All the bedrooms on the second floor share access to the true highlight of this level—the expansive open-air balcony, offering comfortable lounge seating and a chaise lounger, with stunning treetop views.
